_note: Ink colours for the postcard message, plus how the ink sits on paper. Hand-written (no script). Sizes are in pt at 1x; scale with the text size.

edgeBleed._note: A soft halo of the same ink under the crisp text: the ink soaks a hair past the stroke. Draw the text twice: blurred first, crisp on top.

typewriter._note: Per-character imperfection for typewriter text. Seed by character index so it never shimmers while typing.

calligraphy._note: Pen ink pools slightly at the start of each word.
